data.body:
[P2] Require coverage for failed-load recovery

The missing-SDK tests reset modules before each failure and never retry the same loader after rejection. The default-client tests cover successful calls only. Removing this reset therefore leaves their assertions unchanged while making a failed load permanently cached; the equivalent reset in `bedrock.ts` also lacks recovery coverage. Under CONTRIBUTING rule 4, return to the loading/cache design and either remove this recovery behavior or require a failure-followed-by-success test using the same retained loader.
